author: Thomas Sankara
en: We must dare to invent the future.
fr: Il faut oser inventer l'avenir.

author: Thomas Sankara
en: He who feeds you, controls you.
fr: Celui qui te nourrit, te contrôle.

author: Thomas Sankara
en: While revolutionaries as individuals can be murdered, you cannot kill ideas.
fr: Si les révolutionnaires en tant qu'individus peuvent être assassinés, on ne peut pas tuer les idées.

author: Thomas Sankara
en: The enemies of a people are those who keep them in ignorance.
fr: Les ennemis d'un peuple, ce sont ceux qui le maintiennent dans l'ignorance.

author: Thomas Sankara
en: Comrades, there is no true social revolution without the liberation of women.
fr: Camarades, il n'y a pas de véritable révolution sociale sans la libération des femmes.

author: Thomas Sankara
en: You cannot carry out fundamental change without a certain amount of madness.
fr: On ne peut pas entreprendre de changements profonds sans une certaine dose de folie.

author: Thomas Sankara
en: Homeland or death, we shall overcome.
fr: Patrie ou mort, nous vaincrons.

author: Thomas Sankara
en: When the people stand up, imperialism trembles.
fr: Quand le peuple se lève, l'impérialisme tremble.

author: Thomas Sankara
en: The struggle continues.
fr: La lutte continue.

author: Thomas Sankara
en: I want people to remember me as someone who served his people.
fr: Je veux qu'on se souvienne de moi comme de quelqu'un qui a servi son peuple.

author: Thomas Sankara
en: We must learn to live in solidarity with the peoples who struggle.
fr: Nous devons apprendre à vivre en solidarité avec les peuples qui luttent.

author: Thomas Sankara
en: The people must be the architects of their own happiness.
fr: Le peuple doit être l'architecte de son propre bonheur.

author: Thomas Sankara
en: Education is the key to freedom.
fr: L'éducation est la clé de la liberté.

author: Thomas Sankara
en: We must give ourselves the means to write our own history.
fr: Nous devons nous donner les moyens d'écrire notre propre histoire.

author: Thomas Sankara
en: I am for the equality of men and women.
fr: Je suis pour l'égalité entre hommes et femmes.

author: Thomas Sankara
en: The worker must be the master of his work.
fr: Le travailleur doit être le maître de son travail.

author: Thomas Sankara
en: We have to work at decolonizing our mentality.
fr: Nous devons travailler à décoloniser notre mentalité.

author: Thomas Sankara
en: The revolution is made by people, not by leaders alone.
fr: La révolution se fait par le peuple, pas par les dirigeants seuls.

author: Thomas Sankara
en: Our country produces enough to feed us all.
fr: Notre pays produit assez pour nous nourrir tous.

author: Thomas Sankara
en: The imperialists want us to be good slaves, not good revolutionaries.
fr: Les impérialistes veulent que nous soyons de bons esclaves, pas de bons révolutionnaires.

author: Walter Rodney
en: Development is not a technical problem but a social and political one.

author: Walter Rodney
en: African development is possible only on the basis of a radical break with the international capitalist system.

author: Walter Rodney
en: The decisiveness of the short period of colonialism and its negative consequences for Africa spring from the fact that Africa lost power.

author: Walter Rodney
en: Under colonialism the ownership was in foreign hands, and the domination was not only economic but also political and cultural.

author: Walter Rodney
en: The only way to solve the problem of African underdevelopment is to solve the problem of the world capitalist system.

author: Walter Rodney
en: African unity can only be based on popular struggles, not on the unity of heads of state.

author: Walter Rodney
en: The people must be armed with knowledge of their own history.

author: Walter Rodney
en: Colonialism was a one-armed bandit; neocolonialism is a two-armed bandit.

author: Walter Rodney
en: The most effective form of oppression is that which makes people believe they are free.

author: Walter Rodney
en: To study history is to study the struggle of the oppressed to be free.

author: Michael Parenti
en: The most powerful instrument of domination is the mental control of the dominated.

author: Michael Parenti
en: Imperialism has been the most powerful force in world history.

author: Michael Parenti
en: The national security state maintains us in a world of enemies.

author: Michael Parenti
en: The essence of capitalism is to turn nature into commodities and commodities into capital.

author: Michael Parenti
en: The problem with capitalism is that it puts profit before people.

author: Michael Parenti
en: History is written by the victors, but it is lived by the people.

author: Michael Parenti
en: Democracy is not about trust; it is about distrust of power.

author: Michael Parenti
en: The media serve the interests of those who finance and own them.

author: Michael Parenti
en: The best way to control people is to control their perception of reality.

author: Michael Parenti
en: Rich nations maintain their wealth by keeping poor nations poor.

author: Huey P. Newton
en: The revolution has always been in the hands of the young.

author: Huey P. Newton
en: I have the people behind me and the people are my strength.

author: Huey P. Newton
en: The first lesson a revolutionary must learn is that he is a doomed man.

author: Huey P. Newton
en: We have to realize that the power is in the hands of the people.

author: Huey P. Newton
en: Black power is giving power to people who have not had power to determine their destiny.

author: Huey P. Newton
en: The task is to transform society; only the people can transform society.

author: Huey P. Newton
en: We were trying to increase the conflict that was already happening.

author: Huey P. Newton
en: The racist dog policemen must withdraw immediately from our communities.

author: Huey P. Newton
en: Laws should be made to serve the people, not people to serve the laws.

author: Huey P. Newton
en: We want freedom. We want power to determine the destiny of our Black community.

author: Assata Shakur
en: It is our duty to fight for our freedom.

author: Assata Shakur
en: It is our duty to win.

author: Assata Shakur
en: We must love and support each other.

author: Assata Shakur
en: We have nothing to lose but our chains.

author: Assata Shakur
en: A wall is just a wall and can be broken down.

author: Assata Shakur
en: Nobody in the world has ever gotten their freedom by appealing to the moral sense of the people who were oppressing them.

author: Assata Shakur
en: I am an ex prisoner. I am a runaway slave. I am a revolutionary.

author: Assata Shakur
en: The first thing the enemy tries to do is isolate revolutionaries from the masses.

author: Assata Shakur
en: Revolution is about love; it is about creating a world where everyone can be free.

author: Assata Shakur
en: Trust no one who tells you to trust the system.

author: Angela Davis
en: I am no longer accepting the things I cannot change. I am changing the things I cannot accept.

author: Angela Davis
en: Radical simply means grasping things at the root.

author: Angela Davis
en: If they come for me in the morning, they will come for you in the night.

author: Angela Davis
en: You have to act as if it were possible to radically transform the world. And you have to do it all the time.

author: Angela Davis
en: Prisons do not disappear social problems, they disappear human beings.

author: Angela Davis
en: The struggle for justice is not a sprint; it is a marathon.

author: Angela Davis
en: We have to talk about liberating minds as well as liberating society.

author: Angela Davis
en: Freedom is a constant struggle.

author: Angela Davis
en: When Black women win victories, it is a boost for virtually every segment of society.

author: Angela Davis
en: Justice is indivisible. You cannot have justice for some and not for others.
